newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices steady on slow consumer demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices steady on slow consumer demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices on Friday were steady in a narrow price band on the local market, dealers said.
Consumer demand however remained slow but limited arrivals from mills kept prices around previous levels.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 was quoted at 1,255/1,270 rupees per quintal while M-30 was quoted at 1,290/1,345 rupees per quintal. Offerings by the sugar millers remained restricted at the lower level which in turn curtailed inflow of sugar from mills to the Bombay market.

Sugar mill delivery moved down to 1,170/1,180 rupees per quintal from 1,180/1,205 rupees per quintal following sluggish outstation buying and lower than expected purchases by the bulk consumers at the mill level.
Overall market sentiments was quiet at the close amid tight money condition.
Bombay sugar markets are closed on Monday for Holi festival (festival of colours).
